test_utils_replicate: test the utils.replicate function that replicates a scalar or sequence element a specified number of times
test_utils_decorator: test the utils.decorator function that provides wrapt-style decorator support for callable objects, functions, and methods
test_utils_get_channel_index: test the utils.get_channel_index function that returns the channel index (1 or -1) from a data format string like NCHW or NHWC
test_utils_variable_like: test the utils.variable_like function that creates a new tf.Variable with the same shape, dtype, device, and trainable status as an existing tensor or variable
test_utils_format_variables: test the utils.format_variables and utils.log_variables functions that format and log variable metadata as a markdown table
